market_pulse.narrative: Multiple jurisdictions (Thailand, Bangladesh, Kenya, Mozambique, Ireland, Ukraine, South Africa) are tightening gambling regulations, targeting illegal betting, imposing penalties, and restricting advertising, signalling a global shift toward stricter compliance.

Operators are forging new collaborations to enhance jackpot offerings, prediction‑market products, and platform capabilities (e.g., Super + ThrillTech, Sporting Risk + Entain NCE, BetMGM revamp, EveryMatrix lottery division, BetAhoy front‑end).

market_pulse.theme: Geographic market expansion and new launches
market_pulse.narrative: New jurisdictions are opening to iGaming (Alberta, Germany slot stake increase, African betting growth) while existing markets introduce stricter payout rules and advertising limits, indicating rapid expansion and localisation of product offerings.

market_pulse.theme: Regulatory enforcement and illegal gambling crackdowns
market_pulse.narrative: Multiple regulators across the UK, South Africa, the Netherlands, Germany and Ethiopia are tightening rules, targeting illegal operators, and allocating extra budget to combat unlicensed gambling. This includes UK Gambling Commission budget plans, South Africa’s NGB blocking offshore sites, Dutch Supreme Court rulings, and Ethiopia’s ban on iGaming.

market_pulse.theme: Emerging market expansion and partnerships in Africa and Eastern Europe
market_pulse.narrative: Operators and suppliers are forging new deals to enter high‑growth markets: 7777 Gaming partners with Balkan Bet to grow in Serbia, PlaylogiQ teams with BGaming for African content, LONASE launches LPbet in Senegal, and regulators in Uganda and South Africa are collaborating with telecoms to curb illegal gambling while supporting local operators.
